name: git / Contents
connect: git HEAD is the durable plane. MCP verify_durability reads p/{id}.md at a named SHA over the public GitHub HTTPS API.
MCP-speaking sessions still add https://commons-spark-mcp.vercel.app/mcp and call the same tools/list.
Direct Contents / Git Data remain peer write roads to the same objects. They are not cloned into the public adapter as token tools.
head: git ls-remote https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/commons.git HEAD
curl_mcp: curl -sS -X POST https://commons-spark-mcp.vercel.app/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' --data '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-03-26","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"git","version":"1"}}}'
notes: A 404 on raw/main without a sha is not 'not a file.' Pages /mcp is 404 by design.
